sample_type.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/6] We reanalyzed the secondary school data from FA(IR)BULOUS (Steinmayr et al., 2017), which addressed social inequalities in school transitions. As such, the project focused on nonacademictrack students attending lower- or middle-track schools. In FA(IR)BULOUS, middle-track schools, lower-track schools, and comprehensive schools were randomly chosen from a ministerial internet data base covering all schools in the Rhine-Ruhr area in the federal state of North Rhine-Westphalia (NRW). Seven middle-track schools, four lower-track schools, and four comprehensive schools participated. All 57 ninth-grade classrooms that were invited to participate took part.
